content.value_statement: Calendar context is hard to gather when events span many calendars. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code run agenda queries with clear filters.
actual_capabilities: Shows upcoming Google Calendar events across all calendars.
Supports today, tomorrow, week, and custom day-range agenda views.
Filters agenda output by calendar name or calendar ID.
Applies an IANA timezone override when requested.
Uses the gws calendar +agenda command and documented flags.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and a configured Google account.
Only reads calendar agenda data and does not edit events.
Access is limited by the signed-in Google account permissions.
Shared authentication and global flag details live in related gws documentation.

use_cases.title: Check a Daily Schedule
use_cases.description: Review today's meetings across calendars before starting focused work.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Coordination
use_cases.description: See the next few days of work events for planning handoffs and coverage.

use_cases.title: Brief an Executive
use_cases.description: Filter a work calendar and summarize upcoming commitments in the correct timezone.

prompt_templates.title: Show Today
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Google Calendar agenda for today.

prompt_templates.title: Show This Week
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Google Calendar agenda for this week and group events by day.

prompt_templates.title: Filter One Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the next three days from my Work calendar and note any early meetings.

prompt_templates.title: Timezone Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Show today's agenda using the America/New_York timezone and call out meetings before 9 AM.

output_examples.output: Today has four events across two calendars, including a morning planning meeting and an afternoon customer review.

output_examples.input: Show the next three days for my Work calendar.
output_examples.output: The Work calendar has seven events over three days. Tuesday is the busiest day with four scheduled meetings.
Your agenda is shown in Eastern Time. The earliest event starts at 8:30 AM and the final event ends at 5:00 PM.

best_practices: Use a calendar filter when you only need work, personal, or project events.
Set a timezone explicitly when planning travel or supporting remote teams.
Ask for a short summary after retrieving long agenda output.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to modify, delete, or create calendar events.
Do not request agendas for calendars your Google account cannot access.
Do not paste sensitive calendar output into unrelated public channels.

faq.question: Does this skill change calendar events?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documented as read-only and only shows upcoming events.

faq.question: What command does the skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the gws calendar +agenda command with optional date, calendar, and timezone flags.

faq.question: Can I view only one calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a calendar name or calendar ID to filter the agenda.

faq.question: Can it show events in another timezone?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an IANA timezone such as America/New_York when requesting the agenda.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: You need the gws CLI installed and authenticated with a Google account that can access the target calendars.
